#ifndef HPC_PARAMS_H

hypothesis: Parallelizing independent output rows with static block scheduling should improve larger cases on the 4-core target; a serial path below a generic size threshold avoids OpenMP region overhead for small matrices. The contiguous-row kernel layout supports this work sharing, but any speedup remains unmeasured.
notes: Unmeasured candidate; correctness and performance are for the controller to evaluate.
transformations: Extracted a row kernel so the same computation is used by serial and parallel paths.
Enabled OpenMP static scheduling over disjoint output rows for n >= 64, retaining a direct serial path below the threshold.
Selected the existing tiled contiguous-row kernel layout; retained tail bounds for arbitrary valid sizes.
